mechanism: Probenecid inhibits renal tubular secretion of allopurinol and its active metabolite alloxanthine, increasing their plasma concentrations and uric acid-lowering efficacy while potentially elevating toxicity risk.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels closely and watch for signs of allopurinol toxicity (rash, fever, hepatic dysfunction); dose adjustment of allopurinol may be necessary when used concomitantly with probenecid.
